integrity.proof_basis: complete binary orbit-distance enumeration, explicit elementary collapses, relative integral homology, and the published small-cube Rips theorem
integrity.reproducibility: A standard-library Python checker reconstructs the original orbit graph, performs finite free-face collapses, and computes finite GF(2) homology.

scientific_limitations: Only a three-coordinate cyclic permutation and scale two are classified; higher scales and explicit third-homology modules are not determined.
One highly relevant full-text preprint could not be inspected, leaving a prior-coverage risk.
Finite computations corroborate, but do not replace, the all-parameter proof; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Three-cycle fixed loci in binary Hamming Rips complexes: an integral mixed-sphere splitting
